name: Trabajador Residente -- Independiente (Self-Employed Worker)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must perform lawful, self-directed lucrative activity in Peru (not under a subordinate employment contract) under the same 'Trabajador' calidad migratoria used for employer-sponsored workers.
Interpol international police clearance certificate and criminal/judicial background clearance from the country of origin.

evidence_required.document: Criminal/judicial background clearance from country of origin

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.h: Trabajador resident immigration status explicitly covers subordinate OR independent lucrative work under one legal category

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Peru). STATUS: DRAFT, THIN SOURCING -- the regulation confirms 'Trabajador' covers independent/self-employed lucrative activity as a matter of law (tier-1), but no independently-confirmed procedural detail specific to the independent modality was found (no minimum income threshold, no professional-registration/colegio requirement, no distinct TUPA procedure code located separate from the dependiente modality) -- every consultancy source found described only the employer-sponsored (dependiente) process in detail. Disclosed as a documentation gap rather than assumed identical to pe_work_permit.json's requirements, since the MTPE-contract and workforce-cap requirements there are specific to subordinate employment and do not logically apply to a self-employed applicant.
